title: Join Our Talent Network (Non-US)
description:
Skillshare is an online learning community whose mission is to connect curious, lifelong learners everywhere and, in so doing, build a more creative, more generous, and more prosperous world. Millions of members come to Skillshare to explore their creativity, learn new skills, pursue their passions, and learn from inspiring teachers and creators around the world.

And just like our community, we’re always learning, evolving, and looking for talented people who are excited to help us build what’s next.

Requirements

Don't See the Right Role? Let's Stay Connected

Maybe you’ve been following Skillshare for a while. Maybe you’re a member, a teacher, or simply someone who believes in what we’re building. Or maybe you came across us today and thought, I’d love to work there.

If you don’t see an open role that feels like the right fit right now, we’d still love to hear from you.

Join our Talent Network by sharing your resume and telling us a little about yourself, what you’re great at, and the kind of work you’d be excited to do at Skillshare.

As opportunities come up, our team can look back at our Talent Network for people whose experience and interests align with what we’re looking for.

At Skillshare, you could have the opportunity to:

  • Work alongside a small, passionate team of creative thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers.
  • Help shape products and experiences used by millions of curious, creative people around the world.
  • Collaborate across disciplines and have meaningful ownership over your work.
  • Bring new ideas and perspectives to a team that values curiosity, creativity, and continuous learning.
  • Help us build the next chapter of Skillshare.

Joining our Talent Network isn’t an application for a specific position, and we may not have the right opportunity immediately. But when something opens up that looks like a strong match, we’d love to already know who you are.

Benefits

Why Skillshare?

  • Our mission: We’re doing work that matters. We connect lifelong learners around the world and empower people to explore their creativity, develop new skills, and pursue the things they care about.
  • Our team: We’re a passionate, creative, and collaborative group that cares deeply about the work we do and the people we do it with.
  • Your impact: We’re a small team, which means your work matters. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully, take ownership, and see the impact of what you build.
  • Flexibility: We believe doing your best work means having the flexibility to live a full life, too. We’re a remote team built around trust, autonomy, and thoughtful collaboration.
  • Your growth: Curiosity is core to who we are. You’ll have opportunities to stretch beyond your lane, learn from people across disciplines, and continue developing your craft.
  • Our benefits: We support our team with benefits designed around flexibility, creativity, learning, and well-being, including unlimited PTO with a required minimum, gender-neutral parental leave, anniversary sabbaticals, and stipends that support creativity, learning, and personal wellness.

Come Build What’s Next With Us

At Skillshare, we believe creativity thrives when different perspectives, experiences, and ideas come together.

We’re committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where people can do meaningful work and feel empowered to contribute. If you’re excited about Skillshare and what we’re building, we’d love to learn more about you.

Share your resume, tell us what you’d love to work on, and let’s stay connected.
